facts.fact: Top Class Education scholarship for SC students: annual family income up to Rs 8.00 lakh
facts.quote: SC students with annual family income up to Rs.8.00 lakh, admitted in a full-time prescribed course in a notified institution, subject to the allotted slots.

facts.fact: The student must be admitted to a full-time prescribed course in a notified institution
facts.quote: admitted in a full-time prescribed course in a notified institution, subject to the allotted slots.

facts.fact: Scholarships are awarded strictly on inter-se merit, within the slots allotted to the institution
facts.quote: Scholarships are awarded strictly on inter-se merit based on the admission criteria prescribed for the course, subject to the number of slots allotted to the institution.

facts.fact: Yes, 30% of the allotted slots are reserved for SC girl students
facts.quote: Yes. Thirty percent of allotted slots are reserved for eligible SC girl students.

summary: Rs 8.00 lakh income limit, notified-institution admission, merit-based award and 30% slots for SC girls confirmed in the scheme FAQ on NSP.
